text:
incident-bot: SEV2 — Routing fallback surge detected. Multiple customers in eu-west are intermittently routed to us-east and back; we're seeing repeated model-variant fallback loops and 5xx spikes. Auto-remedy failed to converge. Paging on-call.

sylvie: on it. What changed in the last deploy window? Any config schema migrations? :eyes:

james: i'm on-call. saw the alert. I can take initial triage. Can someone paste the diff/PR that went out ~10:40 UTC? @marta ?

marta: we merged a small configschema migration at 10:42 to remove deprecated field `preferred_region` (was shadowed by `region_hint`). The migration replaced implicit default behavior with explicit fallthrough semantics. We thought it was safe but the deploy ship happened right after.

kevin: copying the PR diff here:
```diff
- preferred_region: eu-west
+ // removed preferred_region, fallthrough now uses default failover=true
```

zara: fwiw, telemetry shows region_preference still referenced by older Dedicated route policies (legacy stacks). Those policies now have an implicit `failover=true` which causes immediate cross-region fallback, then the routing runtime sees incompatible model variants and falls back again — loop.

james: confirmed: error traces show `variant_incompatible` + `route_fallback` alternating. Customers hit ~3-4 seconds extra latency then 503. Affected: 9 enterprise tenants in eu-west (approx 12% of requests for that region).

luis: we're also seeing KV cache miss storms when requests jump regions which amplifies token latency and causes queueing. Repeated retries are worsening the loop.

sylvie: mitigation options:
- rollback the schema migration (fast, but requires deploy and config validation)
- patch routing runtime to treat missing `preferred_region` as "preserve region when possible" for 1h
- add temporary explicit policy that pins top-tenant routes to eu-west

james: priority is customer-facing mitigation. I'm going to push a temporary route pin for the most impacted tenants. @kevin can you prepare the curl update?

kevin: yes. Pushing now.
```
# curl to update route
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/routes/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"tenant_id": "acct-47", "route_override": {"region": "eu-west", "force": true}}'
```

marta: i'll notify the affected customers with a short heads-up. PM note: we pushed the schema migration to main to remove deprecated fields; we'll redact that from release notes until we confirm roll-forward.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-15T10:42Z applied to service routing-service (sha: a1b2c3). No automatic rollback configured for schema-only changes.

zara: route pins went live for top-5 tenants. Observability: latency dropped ~30% for pinned tenants within 2 minutes. Non-pinned tenants still see oscillation.

james: good. Next: i'll start a rollback of the schema change in a controlled canary (1/10 traffic) while we keep pins in place. Sylvie, can you watch for fallback loop reappearance? @sylvie

sylvie: watching. adding tracing and enabling debug logs on routing-service for eu-west clusters.

kevin: canary rollback started. cmd:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing-service -n prod --to-revision=20260314-9
```

luis: note: cache warming will be needed after rollback to avoid transient latency spikes. We should avoid killing all pods at once.

marta: customer update drafted: "We're investigating elevated latencies and intermittent errors originating from an internal routing configuration change. We're applying targeted mitigations and will follow up with a postmortem." sending now.

james: can we quantify impact? Grafana: eu-west 5xx rate peaked at 6.8% between 10:43-10:49 UTC. Overall platform error budget usage +0.9% this window. Tenants impacted: acct-47, acct-92, acct-113, acct-201, acct-309 (high-priority).

zara: alerting: paging remains open until rollback completes and error rate <1% for 15m.

sylvie: rollback completed to previous config schema revision at 10:58. Observability shows steady decline of fallback errors. 5xx down to 0.9% after 12 minutes.

james: excellent. i'm closing the urgent paging but keep a hot path for 30m monitoring. we'll schedule a postmortem.

marta: action items:
- product: review the config schema change process and gating (marta)
- eng-runtime: add a temporary runtime guard to treat missing deprecated fields as benign for 72h (sylvie)
- infra: add integration test for legacy Dedicated route policies using both `preferred_region` and `region_hint` (kevin)
- ops: customer outreach followups (zara)

sylvie: assigning postmortem owner: sylvie. I'll collect traces, deploy logs, and the exact PR. ETA first draft 2026-03-16 EOD.

james: thumbs — great work triaging. closing thread once PM confirms customer messages sent.

marta: sent. closing incident as mitigated. follow-ups in #postmortems and the later RCA doc. :white_check_mark:
